en: An old, colorized postcard depicting a large medieval castle complex on a hill with high stone walls and a prominent round tower on the right. In the foreground there are gardens, paths, and small buildings. The structure appears fortified, with a long rectangular wing and small windows. The card shows signs of age with creases and worn edges. At the top left, text states the location.
